changeSet.author: recognition-wallet
changeSet.comment: Only statuses the application undersands may be stored.
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE wallets DROP CONSTRAINT chk_wallets_status;

changeSet.author: recognition-wallet
changeSet.comment: Closed reason is only required when a wallet is closed.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE wallets ADD CONSTRAINT chk_wallets_closed_fields CHECK ( (status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'ACTIVE' AND closed_at IS NULL AND closed_reason IS NULL) )
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE wallets DROP CONSTRAINT chk_wallets_closed_fields;
